es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: US appeals court rejects ‘fair use’ defense over AI training – as Thomson Reuters wins copyright case backed by RIAA and NMPA
items.summary: US federal appeals court has upheld a ruling that an AI company's copying of protected material to build its training data was not fair use. Source

items.title: Trump’s DoJ was biased and wrong about ‘fair use’, say news orgs in OpenAI dispute
items.summary: Many of the music industry’s AI legal battles swing on whether or not AI training is ‘fair use’ under US copyright law. Donald Trump’s DoJ recently intervened in a dispute between newspapers and OpenAI insisting AI training is fair use. The newspapers have responded, explaining why the DoJ is wrong

items.title: Universal Music Group sues DistroKid over AI music, copyright claims
Engram groovebox blends traditional sampling with generative AI
items.summary: Its creator Evan King is well on the way to his $10.6k Kickstarter goal for this “generative audio sampler and groovebox” The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Suno confirms v6 is trained on user-generated interactions as new copyright lawsuits surface

items.summary: Independent-publishing bodies Impel and IMPF are the latest music-industry orgs to set out some principles for how AI-music licensing should work. items.title: Prosecutors want man who pocketed $8m using AI songs and bot streams imprisoned for at least 46 months, saying he stole from ‘hard-working’ songwriters
items.summary: Prosecutors have put Smith's emails in front of Judge Koeltl, and say they show a man who knew from the start that his scheme was fraud. Source

items.summary: Outkast have sued Ovrkast for trademark infringement. Rapper and producer Ovrkast admitted himself in a Rolling Stone interview last year that lots of people confuse the two artist brands. items.summary: The two organizations are now calling on collective management organizations (CMOs) and other licensors to support the principles. Source

items.title: Feds Want Nearly 4 Years in Prison for AI Music Fraudster Who ‘Stole Millions’
items.summary: Prosecutors are urging the judge to sentence Michael Smith to 46 months in federal prison to "send a clear message"

tip.title: Documenta tu aporte humano cuando uses IA
tip.body: Las oficinas de derechos de autor protegen la parte creada por una persona. Guarda prompts, versiones, ediciones y decisiones de mezcla: eso es lo que sostiene tu autoría sobre el resultado.

tip.title: Document your human contribution when using AI
tip.body: Copyright offices protect the human-created portion. Keep prompts, versions, edits and mix decisions —that record is what supports your authorship over the final result.
